args.body: For the existing INVOICE-PEPPOL-SUBTOTAL-FIT mission, use director-rule-excerpts.json if it commits. Verify the test and message fields against the original captures. If extraction is incomplete, read the saved originals. The commercial decision hinges on whether the actual checker can report a line-sum discrepancy without misleading a buyer about document-level adjustments. In the adjustment control, keep the line sum fixed and change the declared document total using one allowance or charge. Save the observed entry-point result and use it to write the supported scope in the existing private example. Reuse equivalent executed work, read back the evidence, and close under a valid lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met.

description: The official Peppol pages for BR-CO-10 and BR-CO-13 both returned HTTP 200. Extract their exact test expressions so the invoice pilot can distinguish a line subtotal check from a document total check before making a buyer-facing claim. Treasury is unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
